content.text: What You Can Actually Get Done Today

The first step towards taking control of your sales is to understand what you can actually get done today. With the right infrastructure in place, you can start selling your digital products in a matter of hours. This isn't about waiting for someone else to give you permission or relying on a third-party service that may or may not work. It's about building your own foundation, using tools like GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, and NOWPayments to create a seamless payment experience.
The Minimum Viable Stack That Works

So what does this minimum viable stack look like? It starts with a hosting platform like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, where you can host your digital products. From there, you can use a backend logic tool like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to handle payments and product delivery. And with NOWPayments, you can accept cryptocurrency payments with ease, using a simple webhook to verify transactions.
Skipping the Steps That Do Not Matter Yet

One of the biggest advantages of sovereign commerce infrastructure is that it allows you to skip the steps that don't matter yet. You don't need to worry about setting up a complicated e-commerce platform or dealing with pesky payment gateways. Instead, you can focus on what really matters: creating great digital products and getting them to market. By simplifying your infrastructure, you can simplify your business and get back to what you do best.
Take control of your sales and payments today.
Getting Your First Transaction Live

Getting your first transaction live is a major milestone, and it's easier than you think. With the right infrastructure in place, you can start accepting payments in a matter of hours. The key is to keep things simple and focus on the essentials. Use a tool like NOWPayments to handle cryptocurrency payments, and make sure you have a clear and easy-to-use payment flow. Before you know it, you'll be raking in the sales and wondering how you ever managed without sovereign commerce infrastructure.
What to Do in the Next 24 Hours

So what should you do in the next 24 hours? Start by exploring your options for sovereign commerce infrastructure. Look into tools like GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, and NOWPayments, and think about how you can use them to create a seamless payment experience. Don't be afraid to get creative and experiment with different configurations - the key is to find what works best for you and your business. With a little bit of effort, you can have a fully functional sales platform up and running in no time.

Creators in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Zimbabwe, and other restricted markets searching for international payment solutions are looking for the same thing: a way to receive USD-equivalent payments from global buyers without a Stripe or PayPal account. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 is the complete answer — Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments deployed under your accounts in 48 hours. For creators who want to self-deploy, the Sovereign Blueprint at $47 covers both stack options with full source code and step-by-step configuration guides. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

To get started with sovereign commerce infrastructure, follow these steps: choose a hosting platform like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, set up a backend logic tool like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, configure NOWPayments for cryptocurrency payments, and test your payment flow to make sure everything is working smoothly. With these simple steps, you can create a seamless payment experience and start selling your digital products in no time.
